ATARI VCS Gehäuse für Raspberry Pi (Pi 5 - 4 - 3B/+)

### Atari VCS Retro Case for Raspberry Pi 5 / 4B / 3B+ / 3B 

Universal 3D Printable Enclosure

 

----------------

A modern Raspberry Pi enclosure with a classic retro soul.

I designed this case as a tribute to the modern look of the Atari VCS released in 2021 — bringing its recognizable lines and understated retro styling into a clean enclosure for modern Raspberry Pi projects.

 

The goal was simple: 

* create something that looks great on a desk, 
* prints easily and FAST!, 
* works across multiple Raspberry Pi generations without unnecessary complexity.
* With its compact shape, ribbed top surface, and subtle retro details, 
* vintage look
It looks great next to a monitor, under a TV, or sitting on a shelf among vintage hardware.

### Compatibility

✔ Raspberry Pi 5
✔ Raspberry Pi 4B
✔ Raspberry Pi 3B+
✔ Raspberry Pi 3B

### One enclosure. Multiple generations of Raspberries.

Whether you're building:

* a retro gaming console,
* a Raspberry Pi home server,
* a media center,
* a compact desktop,
* a self-hosted project,
* a smart home controller,
* or just want a clean and distinctive case for your Pi 
This enclosure is the one to go with.

### Easy and FAST to print

* Optimized for FDM 
* Clean geometry and straightforward assembly
* Minimal support material required
* Looks great even with standard print profiles

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.2mm layer, 2 walls, 15% infill
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PETG (#000000)
